test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six letters P, Q, R, S, T and U are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the following figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55419ec71740a60072be3e17b15c3b4853f2a1aa5ff0fec8851ea6e880b822ad.png]
solution:
From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As P is common on both the dice, it is clear that S, T, R, and Q are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e., U will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82f08ba3d222de504e779f10c93012d34cb628479d76a6600e224ec394293eed.png] 

Opposite pairs:

T → Q

S → R

P → U

So, the opposite side of "S" will be side "R".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
